content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the kaunas district court the court made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property between the plaintiff and the defendant the plaintiff owned an opel zafira car and the defendant owned a nissan tiida car the court recognized that the acquisition of domestic appliances improved the living conditions of the household and awarded compensation to the plaintiff for the value of the property the court also ordered the defendant to pay the plaintiff monetary compensation for improvements made to the plaintiffs personal property the court discussed various contracts and agreements entered into by the parties over the years including lease agreements consumer credit agreements and a donation contract the court awarded the opel zafira car to one spouse and the nissan tiida car to the other spouse the defendant remains personally liable for a consumer credit debt the court awarded the defendant compensation for substantial improvements made to the plaintiffs personal property the court also determined the costs to be paid by each party including stamp duty lawyers fees and mediation costs the court upheld the action in full and upheld the counterclaim in part the marriage between the parties has been terminated and certain personal property rights have been retained

metadata.cost: - € 126,00 (stamp duty) + € 300,00 (professional fees) + € 100,00 (mediation costs) + € 6,64 (court fees) to be borne by the defendant; € 94,25 (stamp duty) + € 125,00 (professional fees) to be borne by the plaintiff
